reasoning: Building a concentrated portfolio that exploits momentum in high-growth semiconductor and technology stocks while taking shorts in secular decliners. This strategy accepts elevated volatility given the three-month holding period without rebalancing, prioritizing exposure to the strongest momentum leaders while betting against laggards showing structural weakness.
